batley.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Batley
s1loc: Batley carries a famous entertainment heritage. Today the long-running Batley Festival fills the cobbled Market Place and Memorial Gardens with arts, street theatre and live performance, while Wilton Park hosts open-air events such as Batley Pride through the summer for crews across the district.
